run_capture_transfer: run the capture transfer pipeline to transfer images from the robot using a dataset name
run_cli: run the capture transfer pipeline CLI with a dataset name argument to transfer robot images
validate_env_vars: validate that all required environment variables are set before running the capture transfer pipeline
run_python_camera_transfer: run the camera transfer script with robot IP, transfer executable, and dataset arguments
review_run_capture_transfer: review the run_capture_transfer function to understand how it validates env vars and invokes camera transfer
